claims.text: Like many female hobbits, Lily was named after a flower.

claims.text: Lily married Tolman Cotton of Bywater. Together, they had five children: Young Tom, Rose, Jolly, Nick and Nibs.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, Appendix C, "The Longfather-tree of Master Samwise"
